trigger: The pinned attestation verifier was raised from gh 2.93.0 to gh 2.103.3. gh before 2.102.0 carries two flaws in flags this repository relies on: GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g (--signer-workflow matched only a prefix of the certificate identity) and GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 (--source-ref compared case-insensitively). Source for both fixes: the cli/cli v2.102.0 release notes (as provided by the owner); the GHSA advisory pages were not reachable from this session. The Phase-0 VERIFIED verdict was produced by gh 2.93.0, so it should be re-checked with a fixed verifier.

commands: bash scripts/ci/install_pinned_gh_attestation_cli.sh   # prints the path of the pinned gh; checks archive sha256 4c806978...
GH=<path printed above>; "$GH" --version   # must print: gh version 2.103.3 (2026-10-26)

for root in live_pg_trusted_root.jsonl fresh_trusted_root.jsonl; do for s in live_pg_evidence.json live_pg_evidence.xml live_pg_role_closure.json live_pg_canonical_manifest.json; do "$GH" attestation verify "$s" --repo kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced --bundle live_pg_evidence.attestation.json --custom-trusted-root "$root" --predicate-type https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 --signer-workflow kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/.github/workflows/ci.yml --cert-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com --source-digest 6ba0bef56f47926ce657515fe1717019522f868b --source-ref refs/heads/main --deny-self-hosted-runners --format json > "verify_${root%%.jsonl}_${s}.out" || echo "FAIL $root $s"; done; done
